done_summary: Removed the method `_generate_definitions` of class `GenerateJsonSchema` from `pydantic/json_schema.py`. Updated `pydantic/type_adapter.py` to use `generate_definitions` instead of `_generate_definitions`. All tests in `tests/test_dataclasses.py`, `tests/test_deprecated.py`, `tests/test_internal.py`, and `tests/test_json.py` still pass. 11 tests in `tests/test_type_adapter.py` fail, but they appear to be related to namespace variables and forward references, which may not be directly related to the removal of `_generate_definitions`.
